notes: California's flat rate for bonuses and stock options; other supplemental pay (overtime, commissions, severance, vacation) uses 6.6%.
California liability excludes the phase-out of exemption credits at higher incomes (not modeled).
Local income taxes (city, county, school district) are not included.
Withholding is a prepayment: the difference between the lines' liability and withholding is settled on the federal and state returns.
